Name: Strawberry Chirps Plushie
Author: KingMadapples
Description:
[i][b]﻿Requires Dynami﻿c Game Assets and all associated dependencies.

[/b][/i]One day, you stumble upon an old and weathered stuffed animal. The colors bleed into one another in a darkened tone, and there is faded lettering upon its left 'foot' labeling the plushie as "Chirps." But where did it come from? Why did it appear in the catalogue? Not even Robin knows.

This mod adds in a single decoration, identified as the "Fruit Bat Plushie," in the furniture catalogue. Special shoutout to Ghostbunny for the fanart that inspired this piece of furniture, as well as the rest of the East Scarp Discord Server for their support!

Manifest.Name: Strawberry Chirps Plush
Manifest.Description: A plushy of your favorite unreleased bat!
Manifest.Author: KingMadapples
